## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// The full post-processing and output configuration of a render pipeline,
// gathering the individual settings records into one value.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Graphics_pipeline)
type RenderPipelineSettings
    implements IValue
{
    Quality: QualityPreset;
    Target: RenderTargetDescriptor;
    AntiAliasing: AntiAliasing;
    AmbientOcclusion: AmbientOcclusionSettings;
    Bloom: BloomSettings;
    Fog: FogSettings;
    ToneMapping: ToneMappingSettings;
    ColorSpace: DisplayColorSpace;
}

// Timing and workload measurements for one rendered frame.
type FrameStatistics
    implements IValue
{
    FrameIndex: Integer;
    CpuTime: Duration;
    GpuTime: Duration;
    DrawCalls: Integer;
    TriangleCount: Integer;
    InstanceCount: Integer;
}

//==
// # Vertex data layout
//
// How the per-vertex data handed to a renderer is packed: the semantic role of
// each attribute stream, its component count and normalization, and the
// interleaved byte layout of a whole vertex. Offsets and strides are in
// bytes.

// The semantic role of one vertex attribute stream.
type VertexAttributeRole
    = Position | Normal | Tangent | Uv0 | Uv1 | Color | BoneWeights | BoneIndices;

// One attribute within a vertex: its role, the number of scalar components
// (3 for a position, 2 for a UV), whether integer data is normalized to
// [0, 1] when read, and its byte offset from the start of the vertex.
type VertexAttributeDescriptor
    implements IValue
{
    Role: VertexAttributeRole;
    ComponentCount: Integer;
    Normalized: Boolean;
    ByteOffset: Integer;
}

// The complete interleaved layout of one vertex: its attributes plus the
// stride in bytes between consecutive vertices.
type VertexLayout
    implements IValue
{
    Attributes: Array<VertexAttributeDescriptor>;
    ByteStride: Integer;
}
```
